exposure: ventrally curved shaft with or without chordee
typical fan shape stream of urinary jet under color Doppler
cohort: Male fetuses undergoing prenatal ultrasound examination.
finding: Fetal hypospadias should be considered in a male fetus presenting with a shortened penis, blunt bulbous tips, ventrally curved shaft (with or without chordee), and a fan-shape urinary jet under color Doppler during prenatal ultrasound, with more severe forms often accompanied by other congenital abnormalities.
